## What changed

One or two sentences. Say what changed, not how you changed it.

## Why

Only if it is not obvious from the change.

## Evidence

The command you ran and what it returned. A screenshot if the change is visual.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests written first, and they failed before the change
- [ ] `make check` passes
- [ ] No hardcoded host, port, or URL
- [ ] Domain names match `docs` vocabulary
